verdict.rationale: Box's marketing copy says users can "access, share, edit, and co-create content", and the developer docs describe reviewers annotating embedded previews in context. That is a glancing claim of in-place editing and collaboration, not a documented co-editing capability. missing for 10: documented real-time simultaneous co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, any named native editor or documented office-suite integration (e.g., Office/Google editors), specifics on formats and concurrency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
